Usage: sink deploy [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  [Group] Deploy site to server with rollback.

Options:
  -m, --method [rename|symlink|local]
                                  Deploy method, default local
  -h, --help                      Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  init    Initialize and setup a deploy.
  new     Upload a new version of the site.
  switch  Change the symlink to point to a different dir in the deploy root.
